t: About Gentle Home: Founding History
s: July 28, 2021 - In the 70s, Al began selling new furniture by catalog, allowing customers to buy high quality, USA made and imported furniture at deep discounts. Catalog sales continued until 2021. In 1981, Bob Davis launched the mattress specialty store Mattress World at the same location – helping San Diegans find quality mattresses at great prices. Fine brands included Organic Mattress Inc, Diamond Mattress, Aireloom Handcrafted, Chattam & Wells, Spring Air and more. In 2014 the website GentleHome.com reflected their focus on all-natural bedding and home furnishings, replacing the old website DavisWorld.com.
